verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics, or usage tracking, and documents no setting to opt out of them. Claims that Open WebUI is 'built to run entirely offline' and offers an enterprise 'Air-Gapped' deployment describe adjacent deployment posture, not a documented opt-out control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
